title: Lunar Bloom Portal
description: A surreal organic portal shaped like a glowing green crescent moon with a serene feminine face floats at the center of a viscous, translucent green liquid structure. Golden light rays pierce through from above while bubbles, paw prints, stylized floral patterns and leafy branches drift within the flowing emerald forms against a deep blue background.
